summary: Thirteen AuthSpec subclasses covering auth methods: NoAuth, PasswordAuth, TokenAuth, JWTAuth, OAuth2Auth, OAuth2AuthCodeAuth, OAuth1Auth, IAMAuth, AzureADAuth, WindowsAuth, KerberosAuth, CertificateAuth, ServiceAccountAuth.

key_classes.name: OAuth2Auth
key_classes.summary: OAuth2 client-credentials/token. kind='oauth2'. Fields: client_id, client_secret, token, refresh_token, server_uri, scope.

key_classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodeAuth
key_classes.summary: OAuth2 Authorization Code grant. kind='oauth2_authcode'. Fields: client_id, client_secret, access_token, refresh_token, token_expires_at, scope.

key_classes.name: OAuth1Auth
key_classes.summary: OAuth 1.0a credentials. kind='oauth1'. Fields: consumer_key, consumer_secret, access_token, access_token_secret.

key_classes.name: IAMAuth
key_classes.summary: AWS IAM credentials. kind='iam'. Fields: role_arn, access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token, profile_name.

key_classes.name: AzureADAuth
key_classes.summary: Azure AD auth. kind='azure_ad'. Fields: tenant_id, client_id, client_secret, managed_identity, msi_endpoint.

key_classes.name: WindowsAuth
key_classes.summary: Windows integrated auth (MSSQL). kind='windows'. Fields: username, domain.

key_classes.name: KerberosAuth
key_classes.summary: Kerberos/GSSAPI. kind='kerberos'. Fields: service_name, principal, keytab.

key_classes.name: CertificateAuth
key_classes.summary: Private-key/certificate auth (Snowflake JWT). kind='certificate'. Fields: private_key, private_key_path, passphrase.

key_classes.name: ServiceAccountAuth
key_classes.summary: Google service account. kind='service_account'. Fields: info, file.

extension_points: Add a new .py file in schemas/ with a new AuthSpec subclass and unique Literal 'kind', then re-export from schemas/__init__.py
lifecycle_notes: Secrets use pydantic.SecretStr. Paths use pathlib.Path.
All models are frozen (immutable) with extra='forbid'.
documentation_hooks: Table of all auth types with their kind discriminator values
Required vs optional fields per auth type
Which backends each auth type targets

evidence.detail: All auth types re-exported at package root
Tests cover NoAuth, PasswordAuth, OAuth1Auth, OAuth2AuthCodeAuth round-trips
